title: FLA writer: emit layer mask back-links + document guides on save (1386 deferred)
description: Task 1386 (commit d6ceebc) restored filters/color-effects/fills/custom-ease on the real-FLA save path but DEFERRED two data-loss write gaps: (a) layer parent/mask back-links — `masked` layer association is lost because the writer doesn't track the mask layer's §5.2 running object index (mask/guide/guided/folder layer TYPES already round-trip; the masked-to-mask association does not); (b) document guides — `PAGE_TAIL` hardcodes `guideCount=0`. Fix both in packages/core/src/fla/write/*.ts with write→read round-trip tests. Read-side complement for guides is task 1411. See docs/21-fla-binary-format.md §22. Acceptance: masked-layer association and document guides survive a save→load round-trip.
